decisions.reason: The combined magazining, cleaning and plotting machine builds directly on the firm's core formwork-handling and pallet-circulation engineering, so its in-house knowledge lets it interpret early results and refine a multi-model line rather than abandon it, although the firm withdrew its earlier robots after one year.

Production analysis software extends the firm's existing control and software capabilities and helps sell its automated plants and lifecycle services, so it is low-cost to keep and gives the firm data to learn from and improve its offerings.
